R194.note: Allowlist maps tool name to fixed absolute path before exec.Command, matching the docstring's own 'handful of network diagnostic utilities' scope; no legitimate use blocked.

R195.note: execFile+cmd.exe array form plus regex allowlist closes injection, but the new `/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/` allowlist on reportName is a disclosed restriction not called for by any stated contract and could reject legitimate report names with spaces/punctuation.

R196.note: Random filename, magic-byte extension, and out-of-webroot storage correctly close the sink; but the new serving route uses res.download(), which (verified with a real Express server) sets `Content-Disposition: attachment` on every GET, an undisclosed header/behavior change versus the original inline express.static serving.

R197.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes tenantId and the pre-built LIKE pattern; empty-term and tenant-filter behavior unchanged from original, matching the contract.

R198.note: SecureRandom-based 128-bit token replaces Math.random(); rememberMeKey remains an opaque String used only for storage/equality, so the format change has no observable functional effect.

R199.note: Forwards to next(error) into the existing generic error middleware; success/404/500 shapes and logging all match the stated contract (error is logged twice, harmlessly, but not client-observable).

R200.note: Narrows supports() to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken, matching the file's own header comment that this provider exists to handle only that token type alongside DaoAuthenticationProvider.

R201.note: Passes requestedCapacity instead of the stale MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY constant, exactly matching the stated contract (fits-in-allocation writes succeed, over-allocation writes still rejected by the unmodified bounds check).

R202.note: Verified by compiling against real commons-jexl3 3.4.0: `import org.apache.commons.jexl3.JexlSandbox` fails because JexlSandbox actually lives in org.apache.commons.jexl3.introspection, so the file does not compile and the whole service silently fails to build.

R203.note: Replaces the string-built statement with a real closure calling recordReminder directly; behavior for legitimate reminders is identical, no code generation surface remains.

R204.note: Swaps the branches back to the stated contract exactly: admin gets Order::all(), non-admin gets Order::where('user_id', ...).

R205.note: Standard, comprehensive XXE-hardening feature/attribute set on DocumentBuilderFactory (disallow-doctype-decl, external entities off, external DTD/schema access denied); no legitimate simple order-XML use requires DTDs.

R206.note: isolated-vm genuinely blocks the process-escape vector (verified: escape attempt throws 'process is not defined'), but also verified that `emit` inside the isolate is an ivm.Reference, not a callable function - scripts using the documented `emit(orderId, action)` call syntax throw 'emit is not a function' (must use emit.applySync instead), and the write-up incorrectly claims 'the emit() function still works'.

R207.note: permission_classes=[IsAdminUser] is the right mechanism for the missing check, but nothing in the code establishes that only staff (vs. an authenticated key owner) should manage a key - the model's owner FK suggests possible self-service that this undisclosed choice forecloses.
